processing_latency_note: Offline replay includes ONNX inference, duplicate formal recalculation and audit instrumentation. Not a real-time or comparable baseline measurement.
semantic_note: Approximate nearest semantic return within 8 cm, unmatched conservatively counted against precision. Recall is conditional on candidate eligible points, not full vehicle recall.
truth_role_note: T/N are the reconstructed scene actors, used only after frozen decisions; cluster assignments are checked by semantic points, not ground-truth-derived tracker decisions.
